about_the_game:
You find a strange puppet that clings to your arm and won’t let you escape. Now, you must find a way to free yourself while uncovering the secrets it hides and how it's connected to Canal 7. Can you uncover the truth before it's too late?

Solve puzzles, discover the story of Canal 7

  • Explore the buried secrets in a first-person horror experience. Read notes and files that never went public and discover what really happened here.

Made with care

  • Immerse yourself in a handcrafted world, carefully designed. Interact with a complex environment, full of details that enrich the atmosphere.

Meet the Puppet

  • You’ll have to solve puzzles and unravel mysteries as you progress through Canal 7, with the goal of freeing yourself from the puppet that clings to your arm. Getting to know it will be inevitable, but waking it... could be the end.

short_description: Puppet Project is a horror game inspired by Chilean television. A disturbing puppet clings to your arm. Find a way to break free… but don’t wake it up. That could be the end of you.
